CITY OF CHEYENNE – PROPOSED AMENDMENT: Amendment No. 1 to the Agenda Item
No. 15 - "PLTA-26-5"



Page 1-line 1                To the entitlement, after "ORDINANCE CREATING
                             SECTIONS 1.1.8, 1.1.9," insert "5.7.1,".

Page 5-line 1                Before "Section 8. That Section 5.8.9 of the UDC" insert:

"Section 8. That Section 5.7.1 of the UDC is created to read as follows:

5.7.1 Data Centers
In districts where data centers are allowed, they shall meet the following standards in
addition to all other lot and building standards for the district. The standards in this section
are adopted to protect the public health, safety, and welfare from impacts common to high-
intensity industrial and energy-consuming uses, including noise, water consumption, fire
and hazardous-materials risk, and infrastructure demand; they apply on generally-
applicable, objective criteria and are not intended to, and shall not be construed to, single
out or inequitably burden any particular project, property owner, or industry. This section
is subject to subsection m (Applicability and Transition) and does not impair vested rights
or rights under a development agreement except to the extent the City lawfully exercises
its police power for the public health, safety, and welfare.
    a. Noise. All data center uses shall comply with the "discernable noise at the property
        line" thresholds and measurement methodology for industrial and machinery uses
        established in the definition of "Discernable Noise" in Section 1.4.3 of this code, or
        shall receive appropriate approvals for an Industrial use, with the following
        modifications:
          1. Rooftop fans. Rooftop fans are prohibited unless fully enclosed within an
              acoustically attenuated mechanical penthouse that satisfies property line
              dBA/dBC limits.
          2. Sound study required. Every data center shall submit a sound study showing,
              at a minimum, the plan view of the site and sound power levels in dBA and
              dBC in all directions and any potentially affected properties. The sound study
              shall also include sound levels under emergency operating conditions.
          3. Exempt Activities. The following shall not be considered activities which
              produce noise discernable at the property line:
                (a) Sound, including data center operation, that is discernable at interior
                    property lines between developments under common ownership or
                    located within a common site plan.
